## Company Updates
**Oct 29, 2025**
# Introducing ChainPatrol.com
The Web3 ecosystem is growing faster than ever, and with that growth comes new security challenges. At ChainPatrol, we understand how critical it is to protect communities, users, and brands from phishing attacks, impersonations, and other online threats.
The Web3 ecosystem is growing faster than ever, and with that growth comes new security challenges. At ChainPatrol, we understand how critical it is to protect communities, users, and brands from phishing attacks, impersonations, and other online threats.
That's why we're excited to announce the launch of our redesigned website, **ChainPatrol.com**, built to provide a seamless experience while showcasing the full range of tools and services that keep leading Web3 projects safe. Our goal is to make it easier than ever for you to explore how ChainPatrol can help protect your users and strengthen your security posture.
## 🚀 Explore ChainPatrol.com
1. ### 24/7 Booking Availability
Scheduling a demo or consultation is now more convenient than ever. We've enabled 24/7 booking, so you can connect with our team whenever it suits you.
![Image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/sVWfJhIVY7i8aOLfQEAsV3U6mk.png)
2. ### Streamlined Landing Page
The new landing page provides a clear, user-friendly overview of our services, making it simple to understand how ChainPatrol protects your brand and community.
![Image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/kXsGYpLrgECnL50rnymjMdfD4.png)
3. ### Fresh Blog Content
Stay informed with our latest articles, case studies, and security insights. Our updated blog now offers a wealth of information to help you navigate the evolving landscape of Web3 security.
![Image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/rHvqU4K47OVzzL83DZtzzJg2wo.png)
4. ### Updated Product Information
Discover the latest features, updates, and improvements to our platform. We've made it easier to understand how ChainPatrol continuously enhances Web3 security.
![Image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/0Fls7xLbhlV6Ma37zxpSkmso7xE.png)
5. ### Refreshed Changelog
Stay up-to-date with all recent updates, bug fixes, and new features added to our platform. Our refreshed changelog keeps you informed about everything happening behind the scenes.
![Image](https://framerusercontent.com/images/KfhSMRK47BOkpbTLlMbRGcx9sk.png)
6. ### New Customer Testimonials
ChainPatrol is trusted by some of the most prominent names in the Web3 ecosystem, helping safeguard their users and communities from online threats. In this section, you can hear directly from clients like MetaMask, TON, Sui, Polkadot, Stellar, and Polymarket about how ChainPatrol has helped them strengthen their security and protect their communities from emerging threats.
## 🔍 Explore the New ChainPatrol.com
Visit [ChainPatrol.com](https://chainpatrol.com/) to explore our revamped website. Whether you want to learn more about our services, read the latest blog posts, schedule a demo, or check out client success stories, everything you need is just a click away.
We're committed to providing top-tier security solutions to protect your Web3 brand and community. The new ChainPatrol.com is just the beginning of making Web3 a safer space for everyone.
